title: AgentApprove
description: Result of agent.approve: the state reached after recording the person's decision. The run's eventual outcome arrives through agent.runState.

state.description: Streaming when a yes or policy decline resumes the run; failed when an egress decline or a refused resume terminalizes it.

warning.description: Consumer-visible sentence when the standing answer could not be recorded or its receipt could not be delivered. The decision on this proposal still stood. Omitted when there is no warning.
